snippet.title: Little Witch in the Woods - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the witch’s tale—our full animation trailer for Little Witch in the Woods! 🌙✨

📌 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594940/
🐦 Follow us on Twitter: https://x.com/SunnySideUp_DEV

A cozy pixel art adventure where you:
🧪 Gather ingredients & brew potions
🏡 Befriend villagers
🌲 Explore the woods
🌙 Restore the village

🌟 Launching September 15, 2025 on Steam !
